prompt: Keep the figure, robe and lighting exactly as in the reference image. A scholar lifts a paper volume from a low shelf and turns it toward a candle; dust drifts through the beam and the pages settle. The camera glides sideways along the aisle past carved wooden shelving, then rests on the open book. Warm candle pools against deep shadow, late night, still air. Bamboo slips, linen thread binding, wax, aged paper.
title: The Candlelit Library
summary: A scholar turns a paper volume toward a candle, dust drifting through the beam.
why: Candlelight is the whole scene, so the prompt names it as part of the locked reference rather than letting the model relight the shot. The action is small and slow — lift, turn, settle — which is exactly the range image-to-video handles convincingly. Dust in the beam supplies the movement, and listing the book's construction keeps the prop from drifting into something generic.
reference_note: Upload a portrait or full-body reference of the figure in period dress, ideally lit by a single warm source. Avoid flash-lit or hard-lit photos and anything with modern props in frame — the model copies the reference lighting and objects more literally than the prompt.
